title: Plenarsuche: semantic search over speeches of the German Bundestag
description: Plenarsuche is a web application for semantic search over the plenary speeches of the German Bundestag from 1949 to 2025, based on the GermaParl corpus of the PolMine project. A user describes a topic in plain language and receives the most similar speeches, ranked by similarity, with speaker, party and date. Results can be limited to a range of years, and selected speeches can be downloaded as PDF files, one per speech. Each speech is embedded as a whole with jina-embeddings-v4; a query is encoded with the retrieval adapter of the same model and matched against a FAISS index. The tool returns the original speeches and generates no summaries or answers. The backend is a FastAPI service and the interface a React application. The record contains the software. The speeches are taken from GermaParl, which the PolMine project publishes under its own terms (the prepared corpus under CLARIN PUB+BY+NC+SA), and have to be obtained from there. A public instance runs at https://germaparl.geolab.soz.uni-bielefeld.de.
